						<article class="post-1379 page type-page status-publish has-post-thumbnail hentry" id="post-1379">
	<div class="entry-content">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Limited availability</h2>
<div class="mk-separator"></div>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Namotu has a minimum 7 night stay with check-in day on Sunday and check out the following Sunday. We do not offer shorter stays or partial-week stays.</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">If you sign up to the newsletter you&#8217;ll receive helpful info to your inbox straight away. Our agent at WaterWays travel will get back to you with a personalised message as soon as possible.</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">As a boutique resort with a small number of rooms, availability on Namotu can be limited. Many groups reserve the entire island and have been returning each year for up to 20 years. We will do our best to accommodate preferred travel dates, but please remain flexible. Any time is a good time on Namotu!</p>
